question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:

Evanescent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Evanescent"** refers to something that lasts for only a very short time, like a fleeting moment or a temporary phenomenon. (क्षणभंगुर)

 
 
• **English Meaning:** Something that is fleeting or vanishing quickly.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** क्षणभंगुर
 
• **Example:** The beauty of the sunset was evanescent, disappearing as quickly as it arrived.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym, **"Lasting"**, refers to something that endures or persists over time, opposite to the fleeting nature of evanescent. (स्थायी)
 
 
• **English Meaning:** Something that is durable or permanent.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** स्थायी
 
• **Example:** Her contributions to the community left a lasting impact on everyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "Evanescent" is "Lasting."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Temporary** (अस्थायी): Something that exists or happens for a limited time only.

 
 
• **Example:** The temporary arrangement was set up to solve the immediate problem.
 
 
 
• **Brief** (संक्षिप्त): Something that is short in duration or concise in nature.
 
 
• **Example:** His speech was brief but impactful.
 
 
 
• **Momentary** (क्षणिक): Something that lasts only for a moment or a very short time.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt a momentary pang of guilt before moving on.
 
 

36:T98a,

The correct answer is** option 4.**
